cases.location: a low alder thicket beside a backwater of the Volkhov
cases.person: a basket maker gathering flexible shoots
cases.circumstances: a night frost has stiffened the ground, but the river edge is thawing and sucking at his boots
cases.situation: He finds several shoots stripped of bark by rodents and hears ice cracking beneath last year's reeds.

cases.location: a clay-floored bakehouse in a village courtyard
cases.person: a woman tending an oat-and-rye loaf
cases.circumstances: the oven mouth is drawing smoke back into the room after wet firewood was added
cases.situation: Her dough is already in the heat, a child is coughing near the door, and a pot of milk is beginning to boil over.

cases.location: a rutted forest road north of the town
cases.person: a carter leading an empty two-wheeled cart
cases.circumstances: one wheel has sunk into a patch of black mud hidden under fallen leaves
cases.situation: The horse is pulling sideways, rain is starting, and the axle makes a new dry clicking sound.

cases.location: a loft above a goat stable
cases.person: a young herder storing dried hay
cases.circumstances: he notices a warm, sour-smelling pocket inside a tightly packed stack
cases.situation: Below, the goats are restless and a lantern must be carried through the narrow hatch to fetch a dropped pitchfork.

cases.location: a shallow reed marsh near Lake Ilmen
cases.person: a fisherman wading to lift a woven trap
cases.circumstances: his foot slides into soft bottom mud while the trap jerks as though something large is inside
cases.situation: Cold wind is raising small waves, and the bank behind him is too steep to climb without using the reeds.

cases.location: a cooper's work yard after a summer shower
cases.person: an apprentice fitting hoops on a water barrel
cases.circumstances: the staves have swollen unevenly and one iron hoop has sprung loose
cases.situation: A nearby brazier is still hot, but the barrel is needed soon to collect rainwater from a roof gutter.

cases.location: a pine-and-spruce forest clearing used by charcoal burners
cases.person: a woodsman checking an old charcoal mound
cases.circumstances: thin smoke escapes from a crack after heavy rain has washed soil from one side
cases.situation: His axe handle is damp, the ground is slippery with needles, and a gust carries sparks toward stacked split wood.

cases.location: a cellar beneath a merchant's wooden house
cases.person: a household servant inspecting stored turnips
cases.circumstances: several roots are soft and wet around their crowns while others remain firm under sand
cases.situation: The cellar air is stale, meltwater is seeping along one wall, and the household needs vegetables for supper.

cases.location: a narrow plank crossing over a drainage ditch in town
cases.person: a man carrying a sack of lime mortar
cases.circumstances: rain has turned the planks slick and a corner of the sack has torn
cases.situation: White powder is spilling onto his wet boot and a cart approaches from behind before he can set the load down.

cases.location: a small smithy beside a busy street
cases.person: a blacksmith repairing a bent sickle
cases.circumstances: the charcoal fire has lost heat after a bellows leather seam split
cases.situation: The sickle has a crack near its socket, rain leaks through the roof onto the anvil, and the customer needs it for morning harvest.

cases.location: a sandy riverbank below a boat landing
cases.person: a boy collecting smooth stones for a sling
cases.circumstances: the river has exposed a patch of dark, foul-smelling mud beneath the sand
cases.situation: A dead fish lies at the waterline, clouds are gathering, and his bare feet keep sinking near the edge.

cases.location: a flax field at the edge of a village
cases.person: a farmer examining young plants
cases.circumstances: some leaves are curled and sticky, with tiny insects clustered beneath them
cases.situation: Ants are moving up several stems, morning dew has not yet dried, and he must decide whether the patch needs attention before hoeing elsewhere.

cases.location: a roadside bathhouse at dusk
cases.person: a traveler warming chilled hands
cases.circumstances: the stove stones hiss when water is thrown on them, but the room has little fresh air and smoke lingers near the ceiling
cases.situation: Outside, his wool cloak is soaked through and his companion is shivering beside a bucket of cold water.

cases.location: a field boundary beside a freshly cut hay meadow
cases.person: a woman searching for a missing cowbell
cases.circumstances: she finds flattened grass, hoofprints, and a place where the animal seems to have pushed through brush
cases.situation: Evening fog is forming in the low ground, and a calf answers from somewhere beyond a wet ditch.

cases.location: a loft where wool is carded and spun
cases.person: a spinner preparing thread for weaving
cases.circumstances: a roof leak has soaked one basket of fleece and stained a nearby dyed skein
cases.situation: The room is cold enough that her fingers are stiff, and an open window lets in damp air and loose chaff.

cases.location: a shallow ford on a tributary stream
cases.person: a messenger crossing on foot
cases.circumstances: recent rain has clouded the water and changed the visible stones beneath the surface
cases.situation: His leather pouch is tied high under his tunic, one boot has a worn sole, and the far bank is clayey and steep.

cases.location: a smokehouse behind a fishing household
cases.person: a woman checking hanging fish
cases.circumstances: one row feels damp and cool while another is hardening too quickly near the fire
cases.situation: The smoke has thinned because a wind shifted, and flies have begun gathering at a gap in the door covering.

cases.location: a birch grove after a windy night
cases.person: a charcoal seller collecting fallen branches
cases.circumstances: a broken limb is suspended in another tree and creaks above the path
cases.situation: The ground is littered with wet bark, his shoulder yoke is already loaded, and a sudden gust is bending the crowns again.

cases.location: a pottery shed near the town wall
cases.person: a potter unloading newly fired bowls
cases.circumstances: several vessels ring differently when tapped and one has a hairline crack under a patch of glaze
cases.situation: The kiln remains hot, a cold drizzle is blowing through the doorway, and a stack of unfired clay has begun to slump.

cases.location: a meadow path beside a beaver-cut stream
cases.person: a hunter returning with a bundle of snares
cases.circumstances: water has spread across the path since morning and fresh gnaw marks cover several willow stems
cases.situation: His trousers are wet to the knee, daylight is fading, and he hears splashing from behind a screen of branches.

cases.location: a covered market bench in early winter
cases.person: a woman choosing a length of coarse cloth
cases.circumstances: one roll feels stiff with frost and another smells strongly of damp storage
cases.situation: Snow blows through the arcade, her mitten is torn, and she needs fabric that can be cut and sewn before the next journey.

cases.location: a wooded ravine along a hunting trail
cases.person: a man with a shallow cut on his palm
cases.circumstances: the cut filled with dirt while he slipped on mossy stones and his hand now aches when he grips a branch
cases.situation: He is alone, rainwater runs down the ravine, and he must climb out before the trail disappears in darkness.

cases.location: a granary porch during a late-summer thunderstorm
cases.person: a farm worker moving sacks of grain
cases.circumstances: wind has lifted part of the thatch and rain is blowing onto the outer sacks
cases.situation: Lightning flashes close by, the porch boards are slick, and a rat darts from a gnawed hole near the threshold.

cases.location: a shallow boat pulled onto a pebbled shore
cases.person: a rower inspecting a damaged oarlock
cases.circumstances: the wooden peg has split after the boat struck a submerged stump
cases.situation: The river current is strengthening, one oar blade is chipped, and the only nearby timber is green willow.

cases.location: a pine-log hut on the outskirts of town before sunrise
cases.person: a woman waking with a severe toothache
cases.circumstances: cold water makes the pain sharper and her cheek is beginning to swell
cases.situation: The household fire is low, she has work waiting at a loom, and the nearest person known for tending injuries lives across muddy streets.
